comment_regular: Oblivion CTL loader called twice at most by FaceGenManager_Construct for FaceGen\\si.ctl. Uses FRCTL001 format marker, reads 0x18-byte header (two scalar outputs + four basis dimensions), loads four named control basis banks, then FanControls data/precomputation. Returns false on read/load failure; destroys binary file on all observed return paths. Header scalar meanings remain unresolved.
